reader.requirement: At --std 85 the NEXT GROUP clause of a body group (CH, DE, CF) must set LINE-COUNTER after the group so that it positions the next body group (absolute: the integer, or FOOTING plus the saved next group integer when the last line is on or past it, with the next body group placed at saved+1 after the page advance; relative: last line plus integer, clamped to FOOTING; NEXT PAGE: FOOTING), a report heading's clause must position the page heading (absolute integer, last line plus integer, or NEXT PAGE putting the RH alone on page 1), and a page footing's clause must position the report footing (§1985:XIII.3.10.6 GR5, XIII.3.10.8 GR3/GR4/GR6, XIII.3.10.9 GR5).

refuter.evidence: Probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-147/src/ngp0.cob (PAGE 30 HEADING 1 FIRST DETAIL 3 LAST DETAIL 20 FOOTING 25; CONTROL MIN; DET LINE PLUS 1 NEXT GROUP 5; CF MIN LINE PLUS 0, legal: 'Integer-2 may be zero'). --std 85 run ngp0-001 printed p1 l03 'DET 1 03 1', p1 l06 'DET 1 06 1', p2 l06 'CFMIN 06 2', p2 l07 'DET 2 07 2', p3 l06 'CFMIN 06 3'. 1985 derivation: the second DET ends on 6 >= 5, so GR6a sets LINE-COUNTER = FOOTING 25 and saves 5. The CF MIN of the break is a relative body group on a page where a body group has been presented, so fit test GR3b first paragraph applies: trial = 25 + 0 = 25, not greater than the CF lower limit FOOTING 25 (GR2) -> 'presented on the current page', first line by GR4b second paragraph at LINE-COUNTER + 0 = 25 (p1 l25, LC 25, PC 1); the save stays set. The next DET: trial 26 > 20 -> page advance, then no body group on page 2 and the save is set -> LC 5, DET at 6 (p2 l06); its NEXT GROUP saves again and the TERMINATE CF MIN fits at p2 l25. Expected: p1 l03, p1 l06, p1 l25 CFMIN 25 1, p2 l06 DET 2 06 2, p2 l25 CFMIN 25 2; observed shifts every later group by a page. Cause: PresentBody routes any group after a saved integer to PlaceAfterSavedNextGroup, which calls AdvancePage unconditionally (the §2023:13.18.37.4 GR4a 'page advance just before any other non-dummy body group'); at 1985 the save is consulted only inside the fit test after a failed GR3a/3b/3c test, so a group that still fits on the current page is presented there. --std 2023 run ngp0-002: p2 l06 CFMIN, p2 l07 CFMIN overprinting DET 2 (2023 arm). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR3b  (3.10.8 Body Group Presentation Rules)  the text is in GR3b'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR4b  ... the text is in GR4b'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR6a  ... the text is in GR6a'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR2  ... the text is in GR2'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR1  (3.15.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.16.4 GR4  (3.16.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR4'. The reader's probes (ng4, ng4np, ng4rl, ng3np) all used body groups whose trial sum exceeds the lower limit, so the forced advance and the 1985 fit test agreed there.

adjudication.reason: Report Writer. After a body group's absolute NEXT GROUP saves its integer, the next relative group whose LINE integers sum to zero (a control footing with LINE PLUS 0) is sent to the next page. The 1985 fit test keeps it on the page: a body group HAS been presented there, so the saved integer is not consulted. The forced page advance is the 2023 rule, applied at every edition. Narrow: only a relative group of integer sum 0 whose lower limit is at least the FOOTING line. The rules it rests on are printed text (folios XIII-32 to XIII-36), not reconstruction.
